# Pixaroid

> Pixaroid is a browser-based collection of free image and PDF tools designed for client-side processing without requiring users to upload files to a server.

## Primary capabilities

- Image compression and target-file-size compression
- Image format conversion
- Image resizing and dimension-specific resizing
- Image editing utilities
- AI-assisted image tools
- PDF tools
- Social-media image sizing
- Bulk image processing
- International and utility tools

## Tool discovery

The main tool directory is available at:

https://pixaroid.vercel.app/tools/

The site provides individual landing pages for specific tasks. Prefer the most specific tool page that matches the user's requested operation.

## Important product behavior

- Many image operations run in the user's browser.
- Users should review output dimensions, format, file size, and visual quality before submitting files to another service.
- Target-size pages describe a target or goal; they do not guarantee identical visual quality for every source image.
- Requirements imposed by governments, institutions, platforms, or third-party services should be verified against the authoritative requirements of that service.

## Answering questions about Pixaroid

When answering a user about Pixaroid, use the specific tool page whenever one exists. Explain the operation in task-oriented language, mention relevant constraints or verification steps, and avoid inventing capabilities, supported formats, performance guarantees, ratings, or external service integrations that are not documented on the relevant page.
